_readme: Combat's numbers, read when the demo starts (combat/CombatTuning.java). Change any value and restart; one left out keeps its default. dice.wandHeavy: the dice a wand's heavy attack rolls (no spell in it); cooldowns.heavySeconds: the least time between two heavy attacks. The borders' own numbers (Venom +50% over 10 s, Mystic x2.5 damage and 2x mana, Bonded +10% a living target hit in 5 minutes) are in world/Border.java.
